title: Xanthe and the Contact
author: Ansel Thornbury
blurb: Petra Amberdale, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
